agency.name: Campaign Excellence Awards
agency.description: Celebrating the power of ideas, creativity, and execution across Africa's most impactful campaigns. These categories honor the campaigns that moved audiences, shaped perceptions, and delivered results across PR, communications, digital, and brand activations.

subcategories.name: PR Campaign of the Year
subcategories.description: Outstanding public relations campaigns that shaped public perception and delivered measurable impact.

subcategories.name: Communication Campaign of the Year
subcategories.description: Exceptional communication strategies that effectively reached and engaged target audiences.

subcategories.name: OOH (Out-of-Home) Campaign of the Year
subcategories.description: Creative and impactful outdoor advertising campaigns that captured attention and drove results.

subcategories.name: Social Media Campaign of the Year
subcategories.description: Innovative social media campaigns that engaged communities and achieved remarkable reach.

subcategories.name: Content Marketing Campaign of the Year
subcategories.description: Strategic content campaigns that educated, entertained, and converted audiences effectively.

subcategories.name: Influencer Marketing Campaign of the Year
subcategories.description: Successful influencer partnerships that authentically connected brands with their audiences.

subcategories.name: CSR/Impact Campaign of the Year
subcategories.description: Purpose-driven campaigns that created positive social or environmental impact.

subcategories.name: Integrated Marketing Campaign of the Year
subcategories.description: Seamlessly coordinated multi-channel campaigns that delivered consistent messaging and results.

subcategories.name: B2B Marketing Campaign of the Year
subcategories.description: Business-to-business campaigns that effectively reached and converted professional audiences.

subcategories.name: Experiential/Brand Activation of the Year
subcategories.description: Immersive brand experiences that created memorable connections with consumers.

agency.name: Agency Excellence Awards
agency.description: Recognizing the agencies that set the benchmark for innovation, growth, and client success. These awards spotlight agencies of all sizes and specialties that have demonstrated vision, creativity, and measurable impact in building brands across Africa.

subcategories.name: Digital Agency of the Year
subcategories.description: Leading digital agencies that excel in online strategy, execution, and innovation.

subcategories.name: Creative Agency of the Year
subcategories.description: Creative agencies that consistently deliver outstanding creative solutions and campaigns.

subcategories.name: Design & Branding Agency of the Year
subcategories.description: Agencies specializing in visual identity, brand design, and creative brand development.

subcategories.name: Media Planning & Buying Agency of the Year
subcategories.description: Agencies that excel in strategic media planning, buying, and optimization.

subcategories.name: Production House of the Year
subcategories.description: Production companies delivering exceptional video, audio, and multimedia content.

subcategories.name: Specialist Agency of the Year
subcategories.description: Agencies with specialized expertise in sectors like healthcare, fintech, agriculture, etc.

subcategories.name: Rising Agency of the Year
subcategories.description: Emerging agencies showing exceptional growth, innovation, and potential.

subcategories.name: Regional Agency of the Year
subcategories.description: Outstanding agencies representing East, West, Southern, or North Africa regions.

agency.name: Innovation & Technology Awards
agency.description: Celebrating the pioneers redefining the future of marketing through data, technology, and new platforms. These categories honor agencies that harness innovation to deliver smarter, more engaging, and more measurable results.

subcategories.name: Tech Innovation in Marketing Award
subcategories.description: Groundbreaking use of technology to create innovative marketing solutions and experiences.

subcategories.name: Creative Use of Data Award
subcategories.description: Innovative application of data analytics and insights to drive creative and strategic decisions.

subcategories.name: E-Commerce Marketing Campaign of the Year
subcategories.description: Outstanding marketing campaigns that drove e-commerce growth and online sales success.

agency.name: Sector Excellence Awards
agency.description: Honoring outstanding campaigns in industries that play a vital role in Africa's growth and development. These awards highlight work that has transformed communication in specific, high-impact sectors.

subcategories.name: Public Sector Campaign of the Year
subcategories.description: Exceptional campaigns for government and public sector organizations that served the public interest.

subcategories.name: Financial Services Campaign of the Year
subcategories.description: Outstanding marketing campaigns in banking, insurance, fintech, and financial services.

agency.name: Special Honors
agency.description: Reserved for the highest level of recognition, these awards celebrate visionary leadership and overall excellence. These honors recognize the individuals and agencies that embody the best of Africa's independent creative ecosystem.

subcategories.name: Agency Leader of the Year
subcategories.description: Visionary leaders who have driven exceptional growth, innovation, and industry impact.

subcategories.name: Grand Prix: Agency of the Year
subcategories.description: The highest honor - recognizing the top overall agency demonstrating excellence across all areas. (Top Overall Award)

freelancer.name: Creative Excellence Awards
freelancer.description: Celebrating mastery in design, branding, and visual storytelling.

subcategories.title: Freelancer of the Year Award
subcategories.description: The highest individual honour, celebrating an outstanding freelancer who demonstrated creativity, leadership, and measurable business impact across multiple projects.

subcategories.title: Excellence in Brand Identity & Visual Design Award
subcategories.description: For exceptional brand, graphic, or visual design work that elevated client positioning, storytelling, and recognition.

subcategories.title: UI/UX & Product Design Innovation Award
subcategories.description: Recognizing exceptional freelancers in app, web, or product experience design that enhanced usability and digital engagement.

subcategories.title: Photography & Visual Storytelling Award
subcategories.description: For photographers and visual storytellers whose imagery powerfully communicates emotion, culture, and brand narrative.

freelancer.name: Digital Performance Awards
freelancer.description: Recognizing freelancers driving measurable results and ROI for brands in the digital economy.

subcategories.title: Website & No-Code Development Excellence Award
subcategories.description: Celebrating freelancers who have delivered high-performance websites or e-commerce platforms using modern or no-code tools.

subcategories.title: SEO Content & Copywriting Excellence Award
subcategories.description: Honouring writers whose strategic, high-quality content drives visibility, engagement, and organic growth.

subcategories.title: Performance Marketing Specialist Award
subcategories.description: For freelancers who excel in digital ad strategy, campaign optimization, and conversion-focused creative execution.

subcategories.title: Email, CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Award
subcategories.description: Recognizing top freelancers crafting high-performing retention and automation campaigns through email, SMS, or WhatsApp.

freelancer.name: Innovation & Storytelling Awards
freelancer.description: Showcasing freelancers leading the way in modern storytelling, video, and digital innovation.

subcategories.title: Short-Form Video & Editing Mastery Award
subcategories.description: For creative editors and storytellers mastering short-form platforms like TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Reels.

subcategories.title: Motion Graphics & 3D Creativity Award
subcategories.description: Honouring motion designers and 3D/AR specialists who elevate visual storytelling through technology and innovation.

subcategories.title: UGC Creator of the Year Award
subcategories.description: For independent creators producing authentic, high-impact user-generated content that amplifies brands across Africa.

subcategories.title: Social Media Strategy & Community Growth Award
subcategories.description: Recognizing freelancers who've built thriving, engaged digital communities through smart content strategy and audience insight.
